name: Dredge Mining Collective Autonomous Resource Survey Platform
product_name: Dredge Mining Collective Autonomous Resource Survey Platform
description: An autonomous aerial and ground survey system that identifies and maps mineral deposits, geological features, and resource concentrations using a combination of spectrographic analysis, ground-penetrating radar, and gravimetric sensing. The ARSP deploys a fleet of survey drones that systematically scan designated areas and compile a comprehensive geological model showing the location, depth, and concentration of every exploitable resource. Dredge uses the platform to identify new mining targets and assess the resource potential of areas under consideration for DEAES deployment.
social_impact: ARSP surveys have revealed that Meridian 88 sits atop significant mineral wealth that was not previously documented — information that has triggered a quiet competition between mining interests and urban planners over the future use of the ground beneath the city. The surveys have also mapped underground water resources, contamination plumes, and geological instabilities that have implications far beyond mining.
story_hooks: An ARSP survey of a Tier 1 district has revealed a massive deposit of a rare earth element directly beneath a residential zone — the mining rights conflict with the residents' right to habitable ground.
ARSP data has been stolen and leaked, showing the exact location of every valuable mineral deposit beneath Meridian 88 — the information has triggered a land-grab that is displacing communities.
